'''Fiona Morrison Porta'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Morrison|Porta}} (born 18 May 1970) is an [[Andorra]]n windsurfer who competed at the [[1996 Summer Olympics]]<ref>{{cite Sports-Reference |title=Fiona Morrison |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/mo/fiona-morrison-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418123800/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/mo/fiona-morrison-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |access-date=3 December 2017}}</ref> and artist who exhibited at the [[55th Venice Biennale]]. <ref>{{Cite web |title=55th edition |url=https://www.andorrabiennale.ad/en/?portfolio=tempus-fugit |access-date=2024-05-20 |website=Andorra Biennale |language=en-US}}</ref>

Morrison competed in the [[Sailing at the 1996 Summer Olympics – Women's Mistral One Design|Women's Mistral One Design]] windsurfing event at the [[1996 Summer Olympics]], and after her nine races she ended with a net total of 153 points and finished in 24th place out of 27 starters.<ref>{{cite Sports-Reference |title=Sailing at the 1996 Atlanta Summer Games: Women's Windsurfer |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1996/SAI/womens-windsurfer.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200417185250/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/summer/1996/SAI/womens-windsurfer.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=17 April 2020 |access-date=3 December 2017}}</ref>
